BOOTSTRAP.origin_relation: seq1，小manifest<=32768；schema_lineage_digest取canonical qualified inventory；snapshot含全task原事实能力/GAP，不编造旧FIRST

FIRST.origin_relation: token/proof ASCII、request/context/source exact raw、canonical RESERVE全nodes；quote nullable，保原zero price；introduced_grants为严格下述tuple，无后减cost推零

RETRY.origin_relation: 当次exactsource/material/proof；原first不可替；response_digest是同TX实际返回canonical响应，receipt_jws_digest nullable

QUERY.origin_relation: result/JWS nullable，proof purpose=result-read/QUERY_ENDPOINT；当前query raw与原op首次材料分开，不能把STAGED当成功

TERMINAL.origin_relation: full原pending签名材料摘要和canonical完整ledger_changes，结果exact bytes；action SETTLE/RELEASE对应SUCCEEDED/FAILED；最终fence同TX核
